plugins.name: quota-guard
plugins.description: Quota guard for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI): stops at a clean checkpoint before you hit your usage limit and resumes the chat by itself after the reset, with phone notifications (stopped, quota reset, working again, done).
